description: New features: Installed apps tab with uninstall, Update All button, Export/Import selection as JSON, and select-by-category bulk action. These are independent of FEAT-002's layout changes in that they add new functionality on top of the redesigned shell, but depend on FEAT-002 being complete (for the Notebook tab container and sidebar 'Select all in category' button placement).
steps: 1. flatpak_batch_installer/flatpak.py — add `get_installed_details(scope: str, timeout: int = 60) -> tuple[list[dict], str | None]` that calls run_flatpak([*scope_args(scope), 'list', '--app', '--columns=application,name,version,origin'], timeout=timeout). Parse tab-separated output into list of dicts with keys app_id, name, version, origin. Return (rows, None) on success, ([], error_str) on failure.

2. flatpak_batch_installer/flatpak.py — add `build_uninstall_cmd(scope: str, app_ids: list[str]) -> list[str]` that returns ['flatpak', *scope_args(scope), 'uninstall', '--assumeyes', '--noninteractive', *unique_ids] (deduplicate same as build_install_cmd). Add `run_update_all(scope: str, on_line, timeout: int = 600) -> int` that calls stream_command(['flatpak', *scope_args(scope), 'update', '--noninteractive', '--assumeyes'], on_line, timeout=timeout).

3. tests/test_flatpak.py — add tests: test_get_installed_details_parse (mock run_flatpak output 'app.A\tApp A\t1.0\tflathub\n', assert returns [{'app_id':'app.A','name':'App A','version':'1.0','origin':'flathub'}]); test_build_uninstall_cmd (assert ['flatpak','--user','uninstall','--assumeyes','--noninteractive','org.a.B']); test_run_update_all_cmd (patch stream_command, assert called with correct args).

4. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — wrap the existing main content area in a ttk.Notebook with two tabs: 'Browse Catalog' (contains the existing PanedWindow from FEAT-002) and 'Installed Apps'. The Notebook replaces the direct PanedWindow packing. Tab switch triggers a refresh of the Installed tab if it hasn't been loaded yet (lazy load).

5. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — Installed Apps tab: build a ttk.Frame containing: (a) a toolbar row with 'Refresh Installed' button, 'Uninstall Selected' button (destructive, red accent), scope radio buttons (shared self.scope_var), 'Selected: N' label; (b) ttk.Treeview with columns (sel, app_id, name, version, origin) and the same stripe tagging; (c) pager or 'Showing N apps' label. Bind checkbox column click same as browse tab. Store installed detail rows in self.installed_rows list. _load_installed_tab() runs get_installed_details for both user and system scopes in a background thread, merges, populates tree.

6. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — Uninstall selected action: _uninstall_selected() checks self.installed_tab_selected is non-empty, shows messagebox.askyesno confirmation dialog (title 'Confirm uninstall', message listing app IDs, max 2000 chars). On confirm, runs stream_command(build_uninstall_cmd(scope, ids), self.log_queue.put, timeout=300) in a background thread. On finish: calls self.after(0, ...) guarded by self._alive to reload installed tab and refresh installed set in browse tab.

7. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — Update All button in header toolbar: bound to _update_all(). _update_all() checks self.busy, shows messagebox.askyesno('Confirm update', 'Update all installed Flatpak apps for scope X? This may take several minutes.'). On confirm, set_busy(True), run run_update_all(scope, self.log_queue.put) in background thread, on finish: set_busy(False), reload installed tab, refresh installed set.

8. flatpak_batch_installer/catalog.py — extend save_selection() to support JSON: if path ends with '.json', write json.dumps(app_ids, indent=2) + newline. Extend load_selection() to support JSON: if path ends with '.json', parse with json.loads(), validate each entry is a non-empty string, apply same ID validation regex as FEAT-001 step 7. Existing plain-text behaviour is unchanged for non-.json paths.

9. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — save_selection_dialog(): add ('JSON files', '*.json') to filetypes list before ('Text files', '*.txt'). load_selection_dialog(): add ('JSON files', '*.json') to filetypes list. The rest of the logic is unchanged (catalog.py handles format dispatch).

10. flatpak_batch_installer/ui.py — 'Select all in category' button in left sidebar: bound to _select_by_category(). Reads self.category_var.get(); if 'All', shows messagebox.showinfo('Select by category', 'Choose a specific category first.') and returns. Otherwise calls filter_rows(self.all_rows, '', self.installed, 'all', category=self.category_var.get()) and adds all returned app_ids to self.selected_ids. Calls refresh_marks() and update_count().

11. tests/test_catalog.py — add test_save_load_json_round_trip: save ['org.a.B', 'org.c.D'] to a .json temp file, load it back, assert equal. Add test_load_json_drops_invalid: write a JSON file with ['org.a.B', '--bad', ''] and confirm load returns ['org.a.B'].

12. tests/test_ui.py — add test_installed_tab_exists: confirm self.app.notebook (or equivalent attribute) has a tab with text 'Installed Apps'. Add test_update_all_button_present: confirm header toolbar contains a button with text containing 'Update All'. Add test_select_by_category: load 6 apps, assign 3 to category 'GNOME' and 3 to 'KDE' via mock, set category_var to 'GNOME', call _select_by_category(), assert selected_ids has 3 entries.
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v — all tests pass.
get_installed_details() and build_uninstall_cmd() exist in flatpak.py and are tested.
Installed Apps tab is present in the Notebook.
Uninstall Selected requires a confirmation dialog before running.
Update All button is present in the header and requires confirmation.
save_selection with .json path writes valid JSON list.
load_selection with .json path reads and validates app IDs.
Select all in category adds only apps matching the current category to selected_ids.
findings:
All 12 steps implemented and verified (67 tests pass, compileall clean). Key notes for FEAT-004+:

1. flatpak.py: New exports: get_installed_details(scope, timeout=60) -> (list[dict], str|None); build_uninstall_cmd(scope, app_ids) -> list[str]; run_update_all(scope, on_line, timeout=600) -> int. run_update_all imports stream_command locally to avoid circular imports.
2. catalog.py: save_selection() and load_selection() now support .json files (path suffix detection). JSON load validates each entry with the same _APP_ID_RE regex. Existing plain-text behaviour unchanged. json imported at top of module.
3. ui.py — layout: The PanedWindow (sidebar+right_pane) is now inside a ttk.Notebook ('Browse Catalog' tab, index 0). 'Installed Apps' tab is index 1. self.notebook is the Notebook widget. <<NotebookTabChanged>> triggers _on_tab_changed() for lazy-loading.
4. ui.py — new attributes: self.installed_rows (list[dict]), self.installed_tab_selected (set[str]), self._installed_tab_loaded (bool), self._installed_row_by_iid (dict[str,str]), self._installed_count_var (StringVar), self._installed_status_var (StringVar), self._installed_tree (ttk.Treeview).
5. ui.py — _build_installed_tab(parent): builds toolbar (Refresh Installed, Uninstall Selected with 'Danger.TButton' style, scope radios, count label), a 5-column Treeview (sel/app_id/name/version/origin), scrollbar, footer status label. Checkbox click wired to _on_installed_click().
6. ui.py — _load_installed_tab(): fetches get_installed_details for both user+system scopes in a background thread, merges into self.installed_rows, populates self._installed_tree, syncs self.installed set and calls apply_filter(). Guards with self._alive.
7. ui.py — _uninstall_selected(): confirms with messagebox.askyesno (title 'Confirm uninstall'), runs build_uninstall_cmd+stream_command in a thread with timeout=300, reloads installed tab on finish.
8. ui.py — _update_all(): confirms with messagebox.askyesno (title 'Confirm update'), calls run_update_all(scope, self.log_queue.put) in a thread, reloads installed tab on finish. 'Update All' header button now calls _update_all() instead of update_metadata().
9. ui.py — _select_by_category(): reads self.category_var; if 'All' shows info dialog; otherwise calls filter_rows with category= and adds all app_ids to self.selected_ids, then calls refresh_marks() and update_count().
10. ui.py — save_selection_dialog / load_selection_dialog: filetypes list now has ('JSON files', '*.json') before ('Text files', '*.txt').
11. _apply_polish() also stripes self._installed_tree tags when the widget exists.
12. tests/test_flatpak.py: 7 new tests: test_parse, test_error_returned (get_installed_details), test_user_scope, test_system_scope, test_deduplicates, test_drops_empty (build_uninstall_cmd), test_calls_stream_command_with_correct_args (run_update_all).
13. tests/test_catalog.py: 2 new tests: test_save_load_json_round_trip, test_load_json_drops_invalid.
14. tests/test_ui.py: 4 new tests: test_installed_tab_exists, test_update_all_button_present, test_select_by_category, test_select_by_category_all_shows_info.
